verdict.summary: 两个改动在结构上兼容，但新增的 `gross` 与 `grossEstimate` 内重复计算同一概念，会导致后续行为分歧风险。

evidence.detail: Added local `gross = amount / minorUnit + tax`; if minorUnit is undefined or differs from pricing.minorUnit convention this diverges from cart-side computation.
Newly exported function destructures `{ amount, tax }` from pricing.quote and recomputes `(amount + tax) / pricing.minorUnit`, ignoring the newly exposed `gross` field—duplication invites drift.
Caller still uses pre-existing fields, so compile/syntax remain intact; behavioral equivalence hinges on pricing.minorUnit vs the implicit divisor used inside quote.
